what: Three overlapping rings at the center of the Section (two thin outline rings + a center circle) — tied to scroll (scrub 1): the two rings spread 40px up and down and scale 1.12x while the center circle shrinks to .8x, and the whole group rotates with no Curve. On wide screens (992px and up · desktop) the group drifts ±100% of its own height around progress .5, passing slower than the Section. Gather Type: two rings come down from 160 and 320px above, gather at one point, then spread, and the group turns 180°→360°. Spread Type: spreads from the Section head, the center circle turns back 90°→−360°, and the group turns 0→360°. Hold Type: stays spread, only the center circle (photo window) rotates −360°, and it fades out with 100px blur at the Section end.

options.look: gather (default — gathers then spreads) · spread (spreads from the section head, center circle rewinds) · hold (stays spread, only the center circle turns)
options.gather: Height in px at which the first ring starts coming down in the gather type, default 160 — the second ring is double
options.grow: Scale when the two rings are fully apart, default 1.12
options.shrink: Shrunken scale of the center circle, default .8
options.up: How many levels up the group to take the trigger section’s parent, default 2
options.drift: Minimum width to enable flow (px), default 992
options.fade: In the hold type, ”off” turns off the fade at the end of each slide

use: — Ring size (560px), border and center circle fill are set in the consuming css

from.where: index.html .fn-thought__orn (gather) · .fn-service__orn (spread — center circle is a gradient ball) · .fn-recruit__orn (hold — center circle is a photo-swap window) — original Top.scroll_animation’s thoughtOrnament · serviceOrnament · recruitOrnament
